description: This file defines interfaces, enums, structs, and macros for handling text conversion, line ending normalization, and related operations in a version control system, likely Git. It includes functions for converting file contents between formats, managing conversion attributes, and streaming conversion support.

classes.name: delayed_checkout
classes.description: Represents a delayed checkout operation with state, filter list, and path list.

classes.name: checkout_metadata
classes.description: Holds reference name, tree object ID, and blob object ID for checkout operations.

classes.name: conv_attrs
classes.description: Stores conversion attributes including driver, actions, encoding, and identification.

classes.name: stream_filter
classes.description: Opaque structure for stream filtering during conversion.

methods.name: convert_attrs
methods.description: Sets conversion attributes for a given index state and path.

methods.name: get_cached_convert_stats_ascii
methods.description: Retrieves conversion statistics for a cached index entry.

methods.name: get_wt_convert_stats_ascii
methods.description: Retrieves conversion statistics for a working tree file.

methods.name: get_convert_attr_ascii
methods.description: Gets ASCII representation of conversion attributes for a path.

methods.name: convert_to_git
methods.description: Converts file content to Git internal format.

methods.name: convert_to_working_tree_ca
methods.description: Converts content to working tree format using specified conversion attributes.

methods.name: async_convert_to_working_tree_ca
methods.description: Asynchronously converts content to working tree format with specified attributes.

methods.name: async_query_available_blobs
methods.description: Queries available blobs asynchronously.

methods.name: renormalize_buffer
methods.description: Renormalizes line endings in a buffer.

methods.name: convert_to_git_filter_fd
methods.description: Converts content to Git format using a file descriptor.

methods.name: would_convert_to_git
methods.description: Checks if conversion to Git format would occur.

methods.name: would_convert_to_git_filter_fd
methods.description: Checks if conversion via filter file descriptor would occur.

methods.name: init_checkout_metadata
methods.description: Initializes checkout metadata with refname, tree, and blob IDs.

methods.name: clone_checkout_metadata
methods.description: Copies checkout metadata and updates blob ID.

methods.name: reset_parsed_attributes
methods.description: Resets internal conversion attribute state.

methods.name: get_stream_filter
methods.description: Gets a stream filter for a specific path and object ID.

methods.name: get_stream_filter_ca
methods.description: Gets a stream filter based on conversion attributes and object ID.

methods.name: free_stream_filter
methods.description: Frees a stream filter.

methods.name: is_null_stream_filter
methods.description: Checks if a stream filter is null.

methods.name: stream_filter
methods.description: Processes input and output buffers through a stream filter.

methods.name: classify_conv_attrs
methods.description: Classifies conversion attributes into categories.
